introduction: After the birth of their son Théo, who has an intellectual disability, Massimo and Claire put aside their dreams to focus on their family. Now 10 years old, Théo wants to go on a ski trip with his community center, unsettling his parents' fragile balance.While Massimo tries to stop him at all costs, Claire sees the trip as a chance for Théo to gain independence, and for them to reconnect.Forced to face their fears, they must question whether their child's disability should define their lives.
